summary.text: Charles Headley is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 91, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Democrat Shelly Fyant. Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican nominee for Montana State Senate District 46 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Charles Headley advanced unopposed from the Republican primary for Montana State Senate District 46 on June 4, 2024, and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Democrat Jacinda Morigeau, 58.3 percent to 41.7 percent.
In 2026 he advanced unopposed from the House District 91 Republican primary.
